items.title: New Unauthenticated DoS Vulnerability Crashes Next.js Servers with a Single Request
items.description: A newly discovered critical vulnerability in the Next.js framework allows attackers to crash self-hosted servers using a single HTTP request, requiring negligible resources to execute. Discovered by researchers at Harmony Intelligence, the denial-of-service (DoS) flaw affects widespread versions of the framework, including the latest 15.x branch prior to the patch.​ The vulnerability resides in…

items.title: Shai-Hulud v2 Spreads From npm to Maven, as Campaign Exposes Thousands of Secrets
items.description: The second wave of the Shai-Hulud supply chain attack has spilled over to the Maven ecosystem after compromising more than 830 packages in the npm registry. The Socket Research Team said it identified a Maven Central package named org.mvnpm:posthog-node:4.18.1 that embeds the same two components associated with Sha1-Hulud: the "setup_bun.js" loader and the main payload "bun_environment.js." items.title: Water Gamayun Hackers Exploit Windows MSC EvilTwin 0-Day to Inject Stealthy Malware
items.description: Water Gamayun, a persistent threat group, has recently intensified its efforts by exploiting a newly identified MSC EvilTwin vulnerability (CVE-2025-26633) in Windows systems.
